ROLE: fix worker for the Mott booking gateway, lane 58 (later/earlier floor from context + Chinese day-parts). Work entirely inside your CWD; never modify anything outside it; no network, no git, no MCP/Apps/skills, no deploys, do not load skills.

CONTEXT - two live defects from a patient test, both reproduced with envelope captures:
(a) The patient was offered 'Friday 12:15 pm or 1:30 pm' and asked 'Any other later time?'. Extraction dropped the constraint (time_after=none), the pinned-day search ran unfloored, and the bot offered 11:00 AM - EARLIER than what was on the table. Same at 'Later time?' after a 12:00/12:15 offer -> 11:15 am.
(b) A Chinese-language patient was correctly offered Thursday morning slots after '星期四早上' (Thursday morning), then wrote '下午' (afternoon) - and the same morning slots were repeated. The day-part authority (lane 56) only knows English words.
Every availability request carries user_text, user_verbatim and context_date (the currently offered slot, e.g. '08/07/2026 12:15 pm').

SOURCE - copy /home/ankit114/repos/ringer/my-manifests/mk2-number-and-comeback/workGW57/gw-vocab4-consolidated/fixed-bland_gateway.py (byte-identical to the deployed lane-57 gateway) into your CWD as fixed-bland_gateway.py and edit that copy. Copy the cumulative test tree /home/ankit114/repos/ringer/my-manifests/mk2-number-and-comeback/workGW57/gw-vocab4-consolidated/gwtest into ./gwtest and extend it; every existing test must still pass.

FIX 1 - RELATIVE-TO-OFFER FLOOR, at the same handler seam as the other verbatim authorities:
1. TRIGGER (all required): (a) user_verbatim or user_text contains a later-form - 'later', 'something later', 'any other later', 'later than that', '晚一点', '更晚' - OR an earlier-form - 'earlier', 'sooner', 'anything earlier', '早一点', '更早' (case-insensitive, whole-word for English); (b) the request carries NO explicit after/before window and NO anchor (the extraction-dropped case); (c) context_date parses AND carries a clock time.
2. ACTION: later-form -> set after to the context slot's clock time so results are STRICTLY later than the offered start (exclusive - the already-offered slot must not be the first result again; if the gateway's existing after semantics are inclusive, add one minute or one grid step before applying). earlier-form -> set before to the context slot's clock time, strictly earlier.
3. NON-TRIGGERS (unchanged): 'later' inside 'later this week/month' (a date qualifier, not a time one) - guard with a negative lookahead for 'this week|this month|next'; explicit windows/anchors present; 'latest'/'last appointment' (existing latest path must keep winning - do not fire when the latest-form matches); no parseable context time.
4. PRECEDENCE: an explicit clock time or day-part word in the verbatim outranks the relative form (existing anchor/day-part authorities run as they do now; this floor applies only when none of them fired).

FIX 2 - CHINESE DAY-PARTS: extend the lane-56 day-part table (same trigger guards) with: 早上 / 上午 -> morning (before 12:00 pm); 下午 -> afternoon (after 12:00 pm); 晚上 / 傍晚 -> evening (after 4:00 pm); 中午 -> lunchtime window (11:00 am - 2:00 pm). These are substring matches (no word boundaries in Chinese). The existing 'good <daypart>' greeting guard stays English-only.

DELIVERABLES in CWD:
- fixed-bland_gateway.py (full edited file)
- proof_later_zh.py - executable proof at the handler-level seam (clamp_availability_range or the pure functions it calls), printing exactly:
  CASE=later-floored AFTER_GT=12:15 (verbatim='Any other later time ?', context='08/07/2026 12:15 pm', after/before none -> effective after strictly later than 12:15 pm)
  CASE=earlier-ceilinged BEFORE=12:00 (verbatim='anything earlier?', context='08/07/2026 12:00 pm')
  CASE=later-this-week-not-time UNCHANGED=true (verbatim='later this week works', context same - no time floor)
  CASE=latest-still-wins UNCHANGED=true (verbatim='last appointment please', time_pref='latest' - floor must not fire)
  CASE=zh-afternoon AFTER=12:00 (verbatim='下午')
  CASE=zh-morning BEFORE=12:00 (verbatim='早上')
  CASE=zh-evening AFTER=16:00 (verbatim='晚上')
  CASE=zh-later AFTER_GT=12:15 (verbatim='晚一点', context='08/07/2026 12:15 pm')
- ./gwtest extended with at least 8 new tests covering both fixes, the later-this-week guard, the latest-precedence guard, and one end-to-end handler test proving the 'Any other later time ?' body yields an after floor strictly beyond the context time.
- DEBUG-GW58.md - what changed, where, trigger regexes, precedence table, known limitations.

HARD RULES: do not weaken, remove or skip any existing test; keep all lane-51..57 behavior intact; keep the file runnable as the single gateway module it is; no placeholder code.
